notes_list.title: Santhal Rebellion (1855-56)
notes_list.basic_overview: Santhal rebellion was a major tribal revolt in eastern India (Rajmahal hills) against the oppressive Zamindari system and British East India Company policies.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
👉 Leaders: Sidhu, Kanhu, Chand, and Bhairav (brothers).
👉 Region: Damin-i-koh.
👉 Outcome: Martial law was declared, and later the British created 'Santhal Pargana' to soothe them.

notes_list.title: Warren Hastings (1773–1785)
notes_list.basic_overview: He was the first Governor-General of Fort William (Bengal) under the Regulating Act of 1773.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
💡 Key Events:
1. Abolished the Dual System of Government in Bengal.
2. Regulating Act of 1773 passed.
3. Founded Calcutta Madrasa (1781) for Islamic studies.
4. Asiatic Society of Bengal formed by William Jones (1784).
